title: Break Point Tennis
overview: When the game is on the line, you need blistering service returns, ball-hammering groundstrokes and an impenetrable net game. You need Break Point Tennis. 8 adrenaline-charged players vie for international supremacy on grass, clay, asphalt and indoor surfaces. With fluid motion-captured animations, 3-D texture-mapped graphics, digitized sound f/x and instant replays to argue those questionable calls, this is tennis simulation at the top of its game!
